info.title: Zenark API
info.description: Personalized AI therapeutic companion. Compatibility routes keep existing clients working; /api/v1 remounts the same handlers.

AI-initiated opening for a new session. Persists only the assistant turn.

post.description:
One-shot transcription for the chat input box.

Does not call the LLM and does not persist a chat turn. The client
must POST ``/chat/send`` after the user reviews the text.

action_payload.title: Action Payload
action_payload.description: Data required by the UI to execute the action (e.g., resource_id, habit_title, booking_flow_id)

ActionCard.title: ActionCard
ActionCard.description:
A structured action card surfaced inside the chat UI.

Action cards are parsed from the LLM's raw output when it emits a
``<<<ACTION_CARD { ... } ACTION_CARD>>>`` block.  The cleaned
conversational text (minus the card markup) is returned separately.

Attributes
----------
card_type : CardType
    Controls which UI component the front-end renders.
title : str
    Short, user-facing heading displayed on the card.
subtitle : str, optional
    Supporting description displayed below the title.
action_payload : dict
    Arbitrary metadata the UI needs to execute the action.
    Schema depends on ``card_type`` — e.g. a TOOL_CARD might carry
    ``{"resource_id": "body_scan_8min"}``.

CardType.title: CardType
CardType.description:
Supported inline action card types rendered in the chat UI.

Values
------
TOOL    : Deep-link to an in-app wellness resource (body scan, breathing)
HABIT   : One-tap habit creation pre-filled from the conversation context
TASK    : One-tap task/action item creation
BOOKING : Surface the professional therapy booking flow
CONTENT : Recommended reading, listening, or video module

ChatMessageRequest.title: ChatMessageRequest
ChatMessageRequest.description:
Incoming chat message from the client application.

Used by both POST /chat/send (JSON) and POST /chat/stream (SSE).

Attributes
----------
user_id : str
    Globally unique identifier for the user (e.g. Firebase UID).
    Used to load memory, mood logs, habits, and graph context.
session_id : str
    Unique identifier for the current conversation session.
    Multiple sessions per user are supported.
message : str
    The raw user message text.  PII anonymization is applied
    before this text is sent to external LLM APIs.

ChatMessageResponse.title: ChatMessageResponse
ChatMessageResponse.description:
Outgoing chat response returned to the client (POST /chat/send).

Attributes
----------
session_id : str
    Echo of the session ID from the request.
reply : str
    The AI companion's conversational reply, with action card markup
    stripped out.
action_cards : list[ActionCard]
    Zero or more structured action cards parsed from the LLM output.
    Empty list if the LLM did not emit any cards in this turn.

ConsultationManualRequest.title: ConsultationManualRequest
ConsultationManualRequest.description: Self by default. Staff may name another user.

HabitCheckInRequest.title: HabitCheckInRequest
HabitCheckInRequest.description: An empty body means today. ``on_date`` lets an offline client backfill.

HabitCreateRequest.title: HabitCreateRequest
HabitCreateRequest.description: A habit the person set for themselves. Never assigned by the AI.

HabitPatchRequest.title: HabitPatchRequest
HabitPatchRequest.description: Rename, retime, pause, or archive. Completion history is untouched.

JournalEntryRequest.title: JournalEntryRequest
JournalEntryRequest.description: New journal entry. user_id in the body is not authorization.

MoodLogRequest.title: MoodLogRequest
MoodLogRequest.description:
One check-in. Only the mood is required, so a single tap is enough.

``logged_at`` is typed as a datetime because ``resolve_logged_at`` ignores
anything else and silently dates the row to now, which would lose the day
an offline entry actually describes.

SessionResumeResponse.title: SessionResumeResponse
SessionResumeResponse.description:
Payload returned by GET /chat/session/{user_id}/resume.

Designed to hydrate the chat UI state in under 500 ms on app launch
so the user sees their conversation history immediately.

Attributes
----------
user_id : str
    The user whose session was resumed.
session_id : str
    The resolved session ID (may differ from the request if the
    most recent session was auto-detected).
is_resumed : bool
    Always ``True`` for a successful resumption response.
last_message_timestamp : str, optional
    ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent message in the session.
dropped_session_context : str, optional
    A human-readable description of where the user left off
    (e.g. "User left mid-thought: 'I was feeling really...'").
recent_messages : list[dict]
    The last 10 messages in the session, oldest first.
    Each dict has keys: ``role``, ``content``, ``timestamp``.
active_emotional_state : str, optional
    The user's last recorded emotional state label, used to
    pre-populate the UI's mood indicator.

SleepLogRequest.title: SleepLogRequest
SleepLogRequest.description: Self-reported night. user_id is ignored for authorization.

SpeechToTextResponse.title: SpeechToTextResponse
SpeechToTextResponse.description: Standalone microphone transcription. Does not send a chat turn.

StreakVisibilityRequest.title: StreakVisibilityRequest
StreakVisibilityRequest.description: Opting out hides streaks from the chatbot as well as the screen.
